grh_b524d2cde67d13f9a26a.title: Murder by Moonlight
paragraphs: On a ship bound for Cavarati, Holmes and Watson secretly protect the returning Rani after the ship's doctor is killed and threats point toward an assassination plot. At a party the Rani is poisoned with arsenic even though her official taster samples everything first. Holmes realizes the taster has been fed increasing doses for a year until he became immune, allowing the same poisoned food to pass safely through him; the conspirator who prepared him also killed the doctor and admits the goal was to prevent a white Rani from ruling Cavarati. The assassin flees as the ship reaches Cavarati waters but is shot by the Rani.

grh_b5f0b1ab6f037bef5100.title: A Whisper in My Ear
paragraphs: Physicist Peter Farrow joins celebrated scientist Miles Baxter to build a machine capable of sending a person's mind through time while leaving the body behind. Baxter covets Peter's work and his wife Kate, and when Peter becomes the first human test subject a power failure leaves his body conscious but apparently empty. Miles urges Kate to institutionalize him, believing Peter's mind is trapped beyond reach. Instead Peter begins projecting his thoughts across time directly into Miles's mind and reveals that Miles deliberately cut the power to steal the invention and Peter's life. Kate cannot hear the voice, so Miles's terrified argument with the unseen Peter makes the saboteur appear to be the one who has lost his sanity.

grh_b59563e92b30a1bde241.title: Song of Norway
paragraphs: Edvard Grieg leaves Norway to pursue his music, while Nina and their friend Rick represent the home and emotional life he repeatedly leaves behind. Grieg and Nina eventually marry, but international success still distances him from both her and the country that inspired him. paragraphs: Identical twins Ruth and Terry Collins frustrate a murder investigation because police cannot prove which sister was with Dr. Peralta when he was stabbed. Terry tries to impersonate Ruth and eliminate the people closing in on her. Police finally trap her by faking Ruth's death, provoking Terry into revealing herself. Cisco, Pancho, and Bill's wife Maggie enter the cavern, survive a dynamite trap, discover the river's hidden route, rescue Bill, and capture the killers.

GRH catalogs The Cisco Kid's "The River of No Return" for December 28, 1954.

The surviving audio runs about 23 minutes.

For broader context, GRH's show profile notes: Cisco and Pancho ride the Southwest confronting outlaws and helping people in trouble, represented here mainly by the Jack Mather and Harry Lang syndicated run plus a rare earlier network broadcast.

GRH classifies the program with genres of western, adventure, and childrens, format episodic drama, and tone adventurous and lighthearted.
